embedder.source: the four files OMEGA's own setup installs for bge-small-en-v1.5 (omega/cli.py), from the same repo at mnimi's pinned revision instead of main; OMEGA's own ONNX inference and pooling

reranker.source: the reranker OMEGA auto-downloads on a fresh install (omega/reranker.py), named explicitly so a larger one left on disk cannot switch in; the same revision mnimi's L2 probe pinned

ingest.source: the type-independent ingest settings of OMEGA's own LongMemEval script (scripts/longmemeval_official.py, ingest_question): store(..., skip_inference=True) and created_at rewritten to the session date shifted so the question date is now (its decay reads created_at against the wall clock); the script's query-side code (query_hint=question_type, per-type recency boosts, temporal-range inference, query variants) is not the library's and is not used

context.source: the shipped mnimi arm's mean rendered context: mnimi__500q_gpt4o_p6time mean reader_prompt_tokens 5,498 minus no_memory__500q_gpt4o's 133 (scaffold and question); the maintainer's decision of 2026-09-27. candidates=100 keeps OMEGA's vector k (5 x limit) under sqlite-vec's ceiling of 4096, which OMEGA would otherwise hit and swallow

competitor.environment: set by the adapter before import: OMEGA_HOME in scratch, OMEGA_ONNX_MODEL_DIR at the laid-out embedder, OMEGA_RERANKER_MODEL=ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2, OMEGA_RERANKER_AUTODOWNLOAD=0, OMEGA_QUERY_EXPANSION=0
competitor.source: OMEGA 1.5.17's retrieval over naive_rag's units (PHASE8 Task 15, R3): one record per round whose content is the round's frozen embed text, the session date as OMEGA's referenced_date; the authors' type-independent LongMemEval ingest (skip_inference, created_at backdated to the session date with the question date as now); query(question, limit=candidates) at the library's defaults (vector + FTS5 + fusion, rule-based decomposition, cross-encoder over the fused top 10, decay, abstention, adaptive retry), no query_hint; LLM query expansion off; the returned rounds' verbatim turns under the context budget
